sources.snippet: Self-hosted, one-tab workbench for the whole training lifecycle: build Character/Concept/Style datasets (generate, scrape, or triage a big dump in the Image Bank), curate, caption, clean watermarks, then train LoRAs on five model families or a full Krea 2 model on a rented GPU, and rank checkpoints in a Test Studio. Free & local. - perfectgf/lora-dataset-studio

sources.title: LoRA (machine learning) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique for large language models and other deep neural networks.
